interface.shortDescription: Design, build and review Kore.ai agents.
interface.longDescription: Artemis Designer creates governed functional, experience and technical designs. Artemis Developer confirms a concise architecture and builds one use case at a time with native ABL and integration tools. Artemis Reviewer coordinates experience and performance specialists, diagnoses evidence-backed findings and independently verifies authorized repairs using available platform tools.
defaultPrompt: Turn this discovery material into a modular Kore.ai agent design package.
Build this agent design with Artemis Developer.
Review this built agent's experience and performance with Artemis Reviewer.
